cases.notes: HONEST FAILURE RECORD: SolveSpace's exposed path fails exactly-redundant systems (probe-verified: duplicate V and duplicate H variants both return flag 1; a trivial duplicate-Horizontal on a single line returns OKAY with dof 2 — not the rank-accurate 3). CAD Sketcher itself treats implied redundancy as a failure mode to engineer around: curve_solver.py:335-352 (issue #674) — 'Submitting them consumes a DOF and, when the quantity is already implied, forces REDUNDANT_OK and flags the group failed' — and gates reference dimensions out of the system; its UI does define a REDUNDANT_OK info state (global_data.py:96-105). SolidCraft solves the same fixture and names the duplicate (TL2 redundant=['k8']).

known_api_divergences: distance_proj() is broken: passes entityA=E_NONE -> GetEntity(0) assertion abort (verified; workaround: raw add_constraint with a real projection line)
mark_dragged() exists in the compiled module (slvs.solvespace.mark_dragged) but is NOT re-exported by slvs/__init__.py

NO constraint mutation API: no delete, no re-value; the only mutations are set_param_value (geometry params) — value edits require full system rebuild (CAD Sketcher's approach)
NO residual/iteration surface: solve returns flags + dof + bad list only; per-constraint residuals are not measurable (TL2 measured them)

scale_performance.method: chain of N alternating H/V line segments, fully constrained (coincident chain to origin, H/V per segment, equal lengths via one driving length dimension, length=1), small deterministic perturbation on the seed; 5 fresh python processes per N (sys.executable, same pinned wheel); wall-clock measured around the solve call only, build time recorded separately; 2-CPU sandbox — absolute times are host-specific, the SHAPE of the curve is the finding

not_measurable_via_slvs_api: per-constraint residuals (TL2 measured constraint_residual; slvs exposes flags + bad list only)
iteration counts and max_residual (SolveReport equivalents absent)
